name: Progressbar
summary: The accessible progress bar — role=progressbar with your real value/min/max and a required label, drawn by the DS Progress.
highlights: role=progressbar with real value, min, max and a required label
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-progressbar> — the a11y wrapper around the DS <aha-progress>. The HOST is the single role="progressbar" in the accessibility tree and carries the consumer's real range: aria-valuenow / aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax straight from value / min / max (3 of 10 announces as 3 of 10, not 30%), aria-label from `label`, and an optional aria-valuetext. The visual is the shipped <aha-progress>, driven with the derived percent and hidden from assistive tech so the bar is announced once; status / size / type / steps / show-info pass through. A value change only updates the persistent inner bar, so its fill animates on the DS motion tokens.
codeNote: Reach for <aha-progressbar> whenever the bar must be announced (quiz progress, upload, a step count). Plain <aha-progress> stays for purely decorative bars that sit next to their own text.

a purely decorative bar next to its own visible numbers
an indeterminate wait with nothing to measure

opinion.note: Never a bespoke <div style="width:%"> bar — it has no role, no value and no name. Always give a label; add value-text when the raw number is not what a person would say. Replaces the aha-design plugin's aha-design-shared-components registry entry (SHARED-04).
opinion.dsv3: Visual is the DS V3 Progress family (see Progress); this contract adds only the accessibility layer.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is a 3-of-10 quiz bar: the host's aria range must be the REAL range, and the inner DS bar must draw 30%.
